agents.intro: Djinn works with the agents below. Install one and sign in from here: Djinn runs each step for you.
agents.intro_none: No agent is ready yet. Djinn needs one to grant a wish: install Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity and sign in, right here.
agents.make_missing: {agent} is not installed on this computer yet.
agents.make_signed_out: {agent} is installed, but not signed in.
agents.next_install: Next step: install it. Djinn runs its installer here; it may ask you a question or two.
agents.next_login: Next step: sign in to your account. A page may open in your browser.
agents.next_unknown: Installed. Djinn cannot tell whether it is signed in: sign in if you have not yet.
agents.step_done: Done. Djinn checked the agent again.
agents.step_failed: The command stopped with an error (code {code}). Read the lines above, then try again.
agents.step_running: Running… Answer in the box above if it asks. Djinn checks again once it ends.

page.action_waiting: {task} waits for your answer to {question} before it may edit.
page.action_waiting_unknown: {task} waits for your answer before it may edit.

page.notes_sub: What the lead wrote for this wish, as written.

provider.title: Change the wish's agent
